items.title: Policeman fined, banned from driving after no ‘causation’ of death found in crash
items.summary: A Hong Kong magistrate has fined a police officer who pleaded guilty to dangerous driving in relation to a crash, but questioned why the prosecution had not brought a more serious charge nor mentioned that another driver had died after the accident. Eastern Court Magistrate Gary Chu Man-hon raised the issue on Wednesday after fining Yip Ka-ho HK$8,000 (US$1,020) and banning the 31-year-old officer from driving for 15 months, following the collision on Morrison Hill Road in Happy Valley last...

items.titleZh: 警员危险驾驶致人死亡案：法官质疑控罪过轻并判处罚款及停牌
items.summaryZh: 一名警员因危险驾驶被判罚款8000港元及停牌15个月。裁判官朱文瀚在判刑时质疑控方为何未提出更严重的控罪，且未提及事故导致另一名司机死亡的事实。
items.whyImportant: 司法机构对警员违规行为的量刑及控罪合理性引发了公众对法律公正性的讨论。

items.title: Police free hostages held in Colombia supermarket after failed armoured car raid
items.summary: Colombian security forces stormed a supermarket in the Caribbean city of Cartagena early on Wednesday, ending a day-long hostage siege – with the president saying all hostages had been rescued and one captor killed. “In an extraordinary joint operation between the National Police and the Armed Forces, all the hostages were rescued,” President Abelardo de la Espriella said. The hostages were seized by a group of armed men holed up ‌in a branch of the Exito chain following a swift police response...

items.titleZh: 哥伦比亚警方在运钞车抢劫失败后解救了超市人质
items.summaryZh: 哥伦比亚安全部队在卡塔赫纳市的一家超市结束了长达一天的对峙，成功解救了所有被武装分子扣押的人质。总统证实行动中有一名劫匪被击毙，其余人质均已获救。
items.whyImportant: 此次成功解救行动展示了哥伦比亚政府在应对突发暴力犯罪时的快速反应能力。

items.title: Rescuers search for dozens trapped in flooded Indonesia gold mine
items.summary: Police say 26 workers are yet to be rescued from a mine that flooded when a nearby river overflowed after heavy rain.

items.titleZh: 救援人员搜寻被困在印度尼西亚被淹金矿中的数十名矿工
items.summaryZh: 由于强降雨导致附近河流泛滥，印度尼西亚一座金矿发生淹水事故。警方表示，目前仍有26名工人下落不明，救援工作正在进行中。
items.whyImportant: 矿难事故凸显了该地区矿业生产中面临的自然灾害风险与安全挑战。

items.title: Books, wisdom keepers and psychic abilities among sources of birth keeper’s knowledge, inquest hears
items.summary: Sita Kali tells NSW coroner ‘there’s a lot of mystery’ around pregnancies involving twins Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A self-taught birth keeper who failed to recognise a woman was carrying twins says she doubted her psychic abilities after two babies died in free-birth tragedies. Sita Kali was present in 2022 when a New South Wales northern rivers baby was born at home three weeks after his hospital-appointed due date – and a week past the point of typical medical intervention. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 调查听证会获悉：书籍、智慧守护者和通灵能力是助产士知识的来源
items.summaryZh: 一名自学成才的助产士在两名婴儿死于家庭分娩事故后，承认自己未能识别出孕妇怀有双胞胎。她在新南威尔士州的调查听证会上表示，自己曾怀疑过所谓的通灵能力，并承认怀孕过程存在许多未知因素。
items.whyImportant: 此案引发了关于非专业助产服务安全性和监管必要性的广泛讨论。

items.title: Is Malaysia’s subsidy tsar next to leave Anwar Ibrahim’s cabinet?
items.summary: Malaysian leader Anwar Ibrahim could lose another trusted ally in his cabinet next month, increasing pressure on the prime minister as he tries to shore up support for his administration while a surging Malay nationalist wave threatens to derail his chances of winning a second term. Anwar, who marked four years in office on Tuesday, has seen three senior ministers exit – or face exits – from his ruling Pakatan Harapan (PH) coalition over the past 17 months as they struggled to win back a...
items.titleZh: 马来西亚的补贴主管会是下一个离开安瓦尔·易卜拉欣内阁的人吗？
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣可能面临另一位内阁盟友离职的风险，这加剧了其政府在应对国内民族主义浪潮时的压力。在过去17个月中，已有三名高级部长离开或面临离开执政联盟的局面。
items.whyImportant: 内阁成员的频繁变动可能削弱安瓦尔政府的执政稳定性及其推行政策的能力。

items.title: Energy bills in Great Britain to rise 26% in January, lifting annual bills over £2,000
items.summary: Ofgem’s price cap will increase for third quarter in a row after rise in wholesale cost of gas Millions of British households will face annual energy bills of more than £2,000 a year for the first time since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, as the cap on energy bills climbs for a third straight quarter. Gas and electricity prices will rise by 26% from January under the government’s new price cap after an increase in wholesale prices not experienced since the first winter after the invasion. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英国能源账单将于1月上涨26%，年度费用突破2000英镑
items.summaryZh: 受批发天然气价格上涨影响，英国能源监管机构Ofgem宣布将连续第三个季度上调价格上限。自俄乌冲突以来，英国普通家庭的年度能源账单将首次超过2000英镑。
items.whyImportant: 能源价格的持续上涨将进一步加重英国民众的生活成本负担。

items.title: More than 300 Russians killed as Moscow props up Mali’s junta, leaked data reveals
items.summary: Exclusive: Records list 349 deaths in three years in Mali and also shed light on Russia’s military activity elsewhere in Africa When the attack on Kidal began before dawn on 25 April this year, the Russian fighters were caught off guard. Within the first hour, checkpoints on the outskirts of the remote desert city nestled among the rocky hills of northern Mali had fallen to the insurgents, who pushed towards the police station where fierce fighting erupted. “Everything was happening at once. Explosions were going off all around us, people were shouting,” recalled a former member of Russia’s Africa Corps who was stationed in Mali at the time and spoke on condition of anonymity. “Nobody knew where the enemy was coming from.” Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 泄露数据显示，莫斯科支持马里军政府期间有300多名俄罗斯人丧生
items.summaryZh: 泄露的记录显示，在过去三年中，有349名俄罗斯战斗人员在马里丧生。这些文件揭示了俄罗斯在非洲地区军事活动的规模及其在当地冲突中遭受的损失。
items.whyImportant: 此数据揭示了俄罗斯在非洲军事干预的深度及其面临的严峻安全环境。

items.title: From stargazing to space: Pakistan watches its first astronaut take flight
items.summary: Students and stargazers packed SUPARCO's auditorium before dawn to watch Zeeshan Ali reach orbit on a Chinese rocket.
items.titleZh: 从观星到太空：巴基斯坦见证首位宇航员升空
items.summaryZh: 巴基斯坦民众聚集在空间与高层大气研究委员会（SUPARCO）的礼堂，共同观看宇航员齐尚·阿里搭乘中国火箭进入轨道。这是巴基斯坦航天史上的重要里程碑。
items.whyImportant: 此次飞行标志着巴基斯坦在载人航天领域迈出了历史性的一步。

items.title: Colombia’s president arrives at scene of supermarket hostage siege in tourist city
items.summary: Abelardo de la Espriella to take control of an operation involving scores of security personnel trying to free at least 20 hostages Colombia’s president has arrived at the scene of an hours-long standoff between security services and gunmen holding at least 20 people hostage inside a supermarket in Cartagena, a popular tourist city. Abelardo de la Espriella’s motorcade arrived in Cartagena on Tuesday night, Agence France-Presse reported, where he will ostensibly take control of a operation involving scores of officers, the navy and special forces. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 哥伦比亚总统抵达旅游城市超市人质劫持现场
items.summaryZh: 哥伦比亚总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯皮利亚抵达卡塔赫纳，亲自指挥针对超市人质劫持事件的营救行动。现场部署了大量安全部队、海军及特种部队以应对至少20名人质被扣押的危机。
items.whyImportant: 总统亲自坐镇指挥突显了政府对处理此类严重公共安全威胁的高度重视。

items.title: Hong Kong tourist spending hits HK$111 billion in first half of 2026
items.summary: Visitors spent HK$111 billion (US$14.23 billion) in Hong Kong between January and June this year, 11 per cent more than in the same period of 2025, with the full-year figure projected to reach HK$238.1 billion, the city’s tourism minister has said. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law Shuk-pui told the Legislative Council on Wednesday that across September and October, Hong Kong saw a 6 per cent year-on-year rise in overnight visitors to 3.72 million, thanks to a series of...
items.titleZh: 2026年上半年香港游客消费额达1110亿港元
items.summaryZh: 香港文化体育及旅游局局长杨润雄表示，今年上半年访港游客消费额达1110亿港元，同比增长11%。预计全年消费总额将达到2381亿港元，且9月至10月过夜旅客人数亦有显著增长。
items.whyImportant: 该数据反映了香港旅游业在经济复苏背景下的持续增长态势。

items.title: Abby Choi’s ex-husband says he lacked legal advice when he named father as killer
items.summary: Slain Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung’s ex-husband has wrapped up his testimony in the murder trial, saying that his former lawyer had not properly advised him when he named his father as her killer. The High Court on Wednesday finished hearing all the evidence in the high-profile trial after Alex Kwong Kong-chi, 31, testified about allegedly being duped by police into giving an inaccurate statement about the influencer’s death. The prosecution contends that Alex killed his ex-wife with a...
items.titleZh: 蔡天凤案：前夫称指控其父为凶手时缺乏法律建议
items.summaryZh: 香港名媛蔡天凤碎尸案审讯进入尾声，被告邝港智在庭上作证，声称此前在录口供时因缺乏适当法律建议，被警方误导而作出了不准确的陈述。控方则坚持认为邝港智是杀害前妻的凶手。
items.whyImportant: 此案因案情极其严重且备受社会关注，被告的证词对案件定罪具有关键影响。

items.titleZh: 比亚迪就轮毂错误致歉；中国汽车买家转向电动车：7篇电动车必读文章
items.summaryZh: 比亚迪因部分电动车轮毂装配错误向公众致歉，此举正值中国政府加强对汽车行业质量监管之际。此外，市场分析显示中国消费者对新能源汽车的偏好持续上升。
items.whyImportant: 中国汽车质量监管力度的加大对比亚迪等头部车企的生产标准提出了更高要求。

items.title: Families of 9 out of 10 helpers killed in Tai Po blaze still awaiting compensation
items.summary: Relatives of nine out of the 10 foreign domestic helpers who died at their Hong Kong employers’ homes in Wang Fuk Court have yet to receive statutory death compensation from insurers a year after the deadly blaze. Under Hong Kong’s Employees’ Compensation Ordinance, family members of each of the deceased workers – nine from Indonesia and one from the Philippines – are entitled to compensation of at least HK$514,510 (US$65,610) for a work-related fatality. A year on from Hong Kong’s deadliest...
items.titleZh: 大埔火灾中遇难的10名外佣中，9人的家属仍未获得赔偿
items.summaryZh: 香港大埔火灾发生一年后，10名遇难外佣中仍有9人的家属未收到保险公司支付的法定死亡赔偿金。根据香港法律，每位遇难者家属应获得至少51.4万港元的工伤赔偿。
items.whyImportant: 外籍家佣的权益保障及保险赔偿效率问题引发了社会对弱势群体劳动保障的关注。

items.title: Is China behind a wave of AI fake videos targeting Taiwan?
items.summary: The network attacked key figures in the ruling DPP, including President Lai and mayoral candidate Shen.
items.titleZh: 中国是否在幕后策划针对台湾的AI虚假视频浪潮？
items.summaryZh: 近期出现的一系列AI生成的虚假视频针对台湾执政党民进党的多位核心人物，包括赖清德及市长候选人沈慧虹。相关网络攻击引发了外界对政治干预手段升级的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 利用AI技术进行政治操弄对地区选举安全及信息环境构成了新型挑战。

items.title: Asia’s markets dive as return of Nvidia’s Huang fails to quell AI doubts
items.summary: Markets fall in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Hong Kong in latest tech-led sell-off.
items.titleZh: 亚洲股市下跌，英伟达黄仁勋回归未能平息AI疑虑
items.summaryZh: 受科技股抛售潮影响，日本、韩国、台湾及香港股市普遍下跌。尽管英伟达高层回归，但市场对人工智能行业前景的担忧依然未能消除。
items.whyImportant: 全球科技股的波动反映了投资者对AI产业估值及增长可持续性的重新评估。

items.titleZh: 从深圳回到美国，特朗普连续4天盛赞中国
items.summaryZh: 特朗普在结束深圳行程返回美国后，连续四天在公开场合对中国给予高度评价。这一反常态的言论引发了国际舆论对中美关系走向的猜测。
items.whyImportant: 美国政要对华态度的转变可能对未来的中美经贸及外交政策产生深远影响。

items.title: Teams Lock in Mission Architecture for NASA’s SR-1 Freedom
items.summary: NASA completed a major review for Space Reactor-1 (SR-1) Freedom and locked in key elements of the spacecraft, which is targeted to launch in 2028 and demonstrate nuclear electric propulsion in deep space for the first time. Experts from across the agency, the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), and industry met at NASA’s Glenn Research […]
items.titleZh: NASA确定“SR-1自由号”空间反应堆任务架构
items.summaryZh: NASA完成了“空间反应堆-1”（SR-1）自由号的关键审查，锁定了航天器的核心设计要素。该项目计划于2028年发射，旨在首次演示深空核电推进技术。
items.whyImportant: 该任务标志着深空探测动力技术的重大突破，对未来长距离太空探索具有重要意义。

items.title: The Nvidia case is just the latest episode of Trump disregarding intelligence
items.summary: Trump’s reaction to sensitive information that contradicts his worldview mirrors his conduct towards war with Iran Donald Trump’s unwillingness to heed warnings of suspected Chinese penetration of the tech giant Nvidia follows a pattern of the US president ignoring sensitive intelligence that contradicts his world view. Trump disregarded repeated information that the company’s co-founder, Jensen Huang, was having an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy that threatened to undermine Washington’s geo-strategically vital goal of pipping China for global supremacy in the artificial intelligence race. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英伟达事件是特朗普无视情报的最新例证
items.summaryZh: 报道称特朗普无视有关英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍存在不正当关系的警告。这反映了特朗普在处理与其世界观相悖的敏感情报时，倾向于采取忽视态度。
items.whyImportant: 此举引发了外界对美国国家安全决策过程以及政府如何应对地缘政治竞争中技术风险的担忧。

items.title: One lame duck and two turkeys as Trump plays the hits at Thanksgiving ceremony
items.summary: Levity was in short supply as president, reeling from midterms rout, talked up his achievements – and fixated on White House vanity project For some, it was his pardoning of the January 6 rioters or the deployment of masked ICE agents. For others, it was Elon Musk’s chainsaw or the demolition of the White House East Wing. Donald Trump’s second term as US president has been full of moments when people exclaim: this is the last straw! But on Tuesday even he went too far. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普在感恩节仪式上表现平淡，引发争议
items.summaryZh: 特朗普在感恩节仪式上回顾了其第二任期的争议性举措，包括赦免国会骚乱参与者及拆除白宫东翼等。外界对其执政风格和近期政策走向表示了强烈关注与批评。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了当前美国政治环境的高度极化以及公众对特朗普政府执政行为的持续争议。

items.titleZh: 感恩节前夕汽油价格大幅下跌，符合特朗普预期
items.summaryZh: 美国全国汽油平均价格在三周内经历了自2008年以来的最大跌幅，降至八个月来的最低点。白宫表示这一趋势符合特朗普总统此前的预测。
items.whyImportant: 油价下跌直接减轻了美国家庭的出行成本，对短期经济民生具有积极影响。

items.title: Zimbabwe issues arrest warrant for Robert Mugabe's son over missed court date
items.summary: The son of Zimbabwe's late former President Robert Mugabe has faced multiple legal troubles in the recent past.
items.titleZh: 津巴布韦对罗伯特·穆加贝之子发出逮捕令
items.summaryZh: 因未按时出庭，津巴布韦已故前总统罗伯特·穆加贝的儿子面临逮捕令。他近期已多次卷入法律纠纷。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了津巴布韦前领导人家族在政权更迭后持续面临的法律挑战。

items.whyImportant: 该事件标志着巴基斯坦在载人航天领域取得突破，并体现了巴中两国在航天领域的深度合作。

items.title: 【 中国ウオッチ 】 現職高官ではなく退職外交官が出迎え◇訪中した高市首相に極端な冷遇 ： 時事ドットコム
items.titleZh: 【中国观察】高市首相访华遭冷遇，仅由退休外交官迎接
items.summaryZh: 日本首相高市早苗访华期间，中方未安排现职高官接机，仅由退休外交官负责接待。日媒认为此举显示了中方对高市首相的冷淡态度。
items.whyImportant: 外交礼遇的规格差异反映了当前中日关系的复杂性及双方在政治互动上的微妙状态。
